slide.title: UK SMEs fund growth on [-personal-] cards because no provider bundles business credit with daily banking
body: Founders put business spend on personal cards. They carry the **personal guarantee** and the limit risk, and the rewards leak out of the business.
Banks won’t lend below £50k, neobanks only offer debit, and legacy card issuers were built for large corporates.

number.caption: typical annual card spend that earns the business nothing back

slide.takeaway: The gap is not credit or banking alone. It is **both, in one product.**
slide.source: FinBridge SME interviews (n = 42); British Business Bank, Small Business Finance Markets 2026.
